critical_checks: P06: unstressed some selects a plural-count or non-count target, and its own dependent phrase excludes external determination, partitives, and relatives.
P08/P09: dependent few selects a plural-count target and excludes the three dependents within its own phrase; this does not exclude the outer the in the few people.
P07/P10: independent uses retain selected partitives and relatives; independent few also permits definite determination and adjectival premodification.
P12/P13/P14: no and none remain forms of one lexeme with constructional form selection; partitives require none.
P15/P16/P20: my and mine remain forms of one lexeme; my lacks ordinary independent argument permission.
P16: the possessor is distinct from the possessed referent controlling independent NP agreement; no first-person or fixed-singular NP agreement inference.
P17/P18: bare singular count book fails its determination requirement; bare plural books passes.
P19: no supplied excerpt establishes some as degree modifier of an adjective; missing information remains not_stated.
the_apple: the article phrase has Det permission, while the whole NP has argument permission through apple.
the_few_people: the determines the outer people NP, whereas few has its own determiner in the lucky few.
boundary: Identifiers, construction catalog, queries, and book/books pairing are supplied. This tests constrained extraction, not autonomous schema design or exhaustive discovery.
